data.title: 迦摩 · 金莲宫殿的粉色花嫁
data.description: 【大奥宇宙宫殿·黄昏】迦摩以成年神性形态穿着黑粉色婚纱坐在金色莲台边，银白长发与金饰被微风托起；她懒洋洋地捧住一束星形花朵，先装作不在乎，随后被镜头看久了而露出不耐烦的红晕。
data.location: celestial lotus palace in the Ooku
data.action: 金色莲台边转动星形捧花装作无聊，被镜头注视后隔纱泛红
data.promptProse: Adult Kama sits on the golden lotus dais edge, rotating her star-shaped bouquet between jeweled fingers and feigning boredom before hiding a reluctant blush behind the veil. Black-and-rose bridal gown and gold trim remain beneath long silver-white hair drifting with cosmic petals. The vertical medium-full view includes lotus layers below and floating flowers behind. Rose-gold sunset illuminates bouquet edges and veil folds, with deep shade between the dais petals.
